triagePolicy.rule: A pending candidate may be promoted only when the ALC1737 witness itself supports a stable guide and Cahita form strongly enough for machine_corrected_unverified transcription. BUE1890 and web OCR mirrors are secondary controls only and may not supply an ALC1737 form.

high_yield_primary_secondary_near_conver.reason: Primary ALC1737 OCR and BUE1890 secondary control are close enough that a direct same-witness facsimile pass is likely to resolve the exact form efficiently, but current policy forbids promotion from OCR/control agreement alone.

form_too_noisy_or_glyph_uncertain.reason: Guide identity is structurally secure, but the exact ALC1737 form remains too OCR-damaged or glyph-ambiguous for promotion.

historical_orthography_or_normalization.reason: The later control reorganizes or normalizes the guide/form, so the 1737 spelling and exact form must be recovered directly from the primary facsimile rather than back-projected.

primary_secondary_form_divergence.reason: The primary OCR and later control disagree materially at form level; retain pending until stronger primary evidence resolves the divergence.

wrapped_or_split_microstructure.reason: The article spans multiple OCR/candidate segments or has wrapped form microstructure; promotion requires direct reconstruction from the ALC1737 facsimile.

nextPassOrder.rationale: Highest expected return from a fresh same-witness facsimile pass; most cases differ only by OCR-level glyph noise.
Guide boundaries are already secure, so work can focus narrowly on the ALC1737 forms.
Requires reconstructing line/candidate continuity before a stable article transcription can be asserted.
Requires distinguishing 1737 witness spelling from later editorial normalization.
Known disagreement makes these poor candidates for automatic strengthening without better primary visual evidence.

epistemicGuards: This queue changes no transcription and promotes no article.
BUE1890 remains a later secondary control and is never silently copied into ALC1737.
Primary OCR from ALC1737 is not treated as equivalent to direct facsimile recollation.
The 22 pending candidates are candidate-level article starts, not a claim of 22 missing historical articles.
No precision, recall, or F1 value is claimed while the p.146 visible-start census remains non-exhaustive.

provenance.method: Conservative Phase II triage of all 22 current p.146 pending_promotion candidates using same-witness OCR plus explicit secondary control, without strengthening transcription.
